Chapter 1009: Chapter 20: The Shock of the Nine Supreme Beings (Subscribe Please)

“The Physical Body Divine Ability I awakened this time…”

Lin Yuan’s heart raced.

Judging from the process of nurturing the Physical Body Divine Ability—it can be concluded:

The longer the nurturing time, the stronger the awakened divine ability will be.

After all, Martial Tao evolves through the principle of survival of the fittest when selecting Physical Body Divine Abilities.

If a divine ability isn’t strong enough, and the nurturing time is prolonged,

it won’t become the final awakened ability; instead, the bloodline will choose a divine ability of the same level with a shorter nurturing time.

Two thousand years of nurturing time—even if the previous six Physical Body Divine Abilities were combined, they wouldn’t reach two thousand years.

“Two thousand years is nothing.”

Lin Yuan felt elated; after stepping into the Twelfth Layer, he had plenty of time. Two thousand years, twenty thousand years, even two million years—what did it matter?

A mere flick of the finger.

Nurturing the Physical Body Divine Ability wouldn’t hinder cultivation, such as restricting one’s strength within a certain boundary. Lin Yuan hardly cared.

“The nurturing of the Physical Body Divine Ability is not only related to one’s bloodline but also influenced by external environments. Thus, using techniques that accelerate time—where a single moment in the outside world could equate to thousands or tens of thousands of years inside—may introduce unpredictable variables in nurturing the ability.”

Lin Yuan pondered to himself.

However, this time visiting Origin Source World, there was no time limit to his stay, so Lin Yuan decided to wait patiently for the nurturing of the Physical Body Divine Ability to complete.

…

“And the Fierce Sun Divine Body…”

Lin Yuan redirected his focus and started observing the changes in his physical body.

After condensing 3,333 Fierce Sun Seeds, all the seeds formed a cycle, impacting and transforming the physical body.

This was what Lord Qingfen referred to as the ‘Fierce Sun Divine Body.’

“Fierce Sun Divine Body?”

Lin Yuan was curious. By reading through countless records of inheritance in the Sky Burning Court, he knew exactly how powerful the Fierce Sun Divine Body was—a physique like a blazing sun, illuminating and consuming everything.

Especially within the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, under the rays of the Eternal Fierce Sun, the unleashed power was even more terrifying.

“The Marquis said I’d need ten thousand years for my physical body to fully transform into the ultimate Fierce Sun Divine Body, but three to five thousand years should suffice.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

As more Fierce Sun Seeds were condensed, the transformation speed of the Fierce Sun Divine Body would accelerate significantly.

Lord Qingfen likely did not anticipate that within just one year in the Sky Burning Court, Lin Yuan would condense eight to nine thousand additional Fierce Sun Seeds.

“The Fierce Sun Seeds cannot replicate within the Chaos Void—this should be due to the dimensional disparity between the two realms. But the Fierce Sun Divine Body?”

Lin Yuan mused, whether it was a type of physique or a divine ability, it operated as a specific manner of rule-driven power. Once comprehended, it could be universal.

Lin Yuan had no intention of transforming his true self into the Fierce Sun Divine Body, but it could be thoroughly tested on his avatars.

After all, such a powerful physique was not weaker than the miracle lifeforms nurtured by the Chaos Void. It could evidently enhance the strength of his avatars.

…

Main Universe.

Inside the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

“The Chaos Rule evolves all ways. What should my way be?” Lin Yuan fell into deep thought.

The Fierce Sun Ancient Country experiences in the Origin Source World had brought Lin Yuan to a new level of understanding regarding rules.

This was understanding—not yet enlightenment.

“Yin and Yang. My way is Yin and Yang. I must evolve Chaos Yin Yang.”

Lin Yuan’s gaze burst with intensity. His Martial Tao was deeply rooted in Yin and Yang—the rotation of Yin and Yang formed Taiji, Chaos Taiji.

Lord Qingfen’s path focused on the Dao of Fire, ultimately evolving into his unique power—the Chaos Flame, or more precisely, the Chaos Azure Flame unique to him.

Even following the same Dao of Fire, the insight gained by individuals varied greatly depending on their life experiences.

Lord Qingfen’s Dao of Fire was centered on “azure” and “burning,” hence earning its name: Chaos Azure Flame.

“With my current understanding of the Chaos Rule, evolving Chaos Yin Yang Taiji is probably impossible.” Lin Yuan tested briefly and came to a conclusion.

At the moment, Lin Yuan’s understanding of the Chaos Rule was at the First Realm. To evolve Chaos Yin Yang Taiji, it seemed he’d need to reach the Second Realm.

Other rule insights ranged from the First Realm to the Ninth Realm, including the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.

But for Chaos Rules, there were only three realms:

The First Realm being the lowest and the Third Realm the highest.

“I still need to enhance my understanding of other rules.” Lin Yuan had a good grasp of what he needed to do.

“The Eightfold Realm of Space-Time…” Lin Yuan turned his focus to the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.

Currently, his understanding and mastery of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule had reached the peak of the Seventh Realm, with the Eightfold Realm within close reach.

Once he achieved the Eightfold Realm in Spatiotemporal Rule understanding, he could use space-time to drive the comprehension of countless other rules and propel his Chaos Rule understanding, likely pushing him into the Second Realm of Chaos Rule.

“Hmm?”

“The adjustment of the Inner Universe is nearly complete.”

Lin Yuan focused his mind and looked towards his Inner Universe.

Since mastering the first layer of “Infinite Void,” Lin Yuan’s Inner Universe had reached a level comparable to that of Chaos Venerables. Adjustments had been underway.

Not that the Inner Universe was imperfect; rather, compared to the Cosmic Starry Skies of the Main Universe, the Inner Universe exerted overwhelming pressure.

Lin Yuan’s Inner Universe spanned only twenty million light-years, but the Cosmic Starry Skies extended far beyond this magnitude.

Why then could Lin Yuan’s Inner Universe rival the Cosmic Starry Skies?

Because the time-space structure of Lin Yuan’s Inner Universe was exceptionally stable. The so-called rivalry with the Cosmic Starry Skies didn’t pertain to size but comprehensive qualities.

Under these circumstances, life-forms of the First and Second Layers found it exceedingly unbearable to survive in Lin Yuan’s Inner Universe, as though they had entered a space where gravity was thousands or millions of times greater than that of the Cosmic Starry Skies.

Even higher-level evolutionaries found it particularly uncomfortable.

This was precisely why Lin Yuan kept adjusting it.

After all, with the impending cosmic destruction, Lin Yuan’s Inner Universe was meant to house all human civilization and its citizens.

“The cosmic destruction event has long been made public in human civilization.” Lin Yuan gazed at the cosmic starry skies.

The revelation of cosmic destruction, paired with the large-scale transfer of citizens, had drawn immense public attention. Following agreements between three goddesses, the matter was made public.

As for which citizens could transfer to the new universe, strict criteria applied.

Firstly, evolutionaries above the Sixth Layer and citizens at the Fourth Level and above were guaranteed transfer to the new universe, surviving the imminent cosmic destruction.

Unavoidable, as evolutionaries above the Sixth Layer held potential for advancement, while Fourth Level citizens made significant contributions to human civilization.

Considering the broader human civilization, they had a stronger claim to survival.

For the vast majority of ordinary citizens and evolutionaries, a lottery system determined transfer eligibility.

On average, one out of every 120 regular citizens and evolutionaries would be chosen to migrate to the new universe.

Lin Yuan’s gaze deepened. The countless planets scattered across the cosmic starry skies came into view one scene at a time.

…

On a life planet.

A colossal starship hovered in space.

“All citizens selected for transfer, please proceed to the star harbor promptly.”

Messages were automatically transmitted to every citizen on the planet, repeatedly.

“Failure to arrive at the star harbor within three days will be regarded as voluntarily forfeiting transfer eligibility.”

…

“Failure to arrive at the star harbor within three days will be regarded as voluntarily forfeiting transfer eligibility.”

…

“Failure to arrive at the star harbor within three days will be regarded as voluntarily forfeiting transfer eligibility.”

…

“Dad.”

A young woman looked sorrowfully at her father.

“Why are you standing there? You’ve won the transfer eligibility—do you know how many people are jealous of you? Hurry to the star harbor.”

The father smiled warmly: “As for your mother and me? We’ve lived most of our lives; born here, lived here, aged here, and we’ll die here—it’s good enough for us.”

“Dad, we want to stay here with you.” Tears streamed down the faces of the children, overflowing with reluctance.

“Stay here?”

“You’re young—why would you stay behind with me to face death?”

The father glared: “Go! I still have to console your mother.”

“If you stay, your mother and I won’t die in peace.”

His tone turned stern, scaring the children into submission.

“Go, now.”

The father turned and stepped back into the house.

Outside, the children hesitated for a moment before boarding the flying vehicle, heading for the star harbor.

Inside the house, the father and an older woman sat together, watching the vehicle fade beyond the horizon.

“As long as they survive…” The father murmured softly.

…

The migration plan for the human race had been underway for hundreds of years.

With so many life planets, limited starships made transferring citizens a slow process.

During this time of migration, scenes of separation unfolded perpetually.

Especially when only one family member won transfer eligibility, parting with loved ones became inevitable.

Many elected citizens couldn’t bear the separation and willingly forfeited their spots, choosing to stay behind with family and friends.

…

Critical Location Three.

The Xuanyuan Supreme Being and eight other human Supremes gathered to discuss the human race’s migration.

“All citizens granted transfer eligibility have reached their designated points, requiring us to send them into our respective Inner Universes,”

The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being said.

The other Supremes nodded in agreement. They were prepared to act at any moment to send citizens safely into their Inner Universes.

At that moment,

Lin Yuan materialized in the one empty seat and sat down slowly.

“Galaxy Supreme Being.”

The Xuanyuan Supreme Being and others’ eyes lit up.

The remaining eight Supremes also turned their gazes toward Lin Yuan.

“How is the migration plan progressing?” Lin Yuan inquired.

“It’s been smooth overall.” Xia Qin Supreme Being replied: “Although plenty of citizens who won transfer eligibility have voluntarily forfeited their spots, prompting several rounds of re-selection.”

“Forfeiting spots—that’s so they don’t part from loved ones,” the Void God Supreme Being remarked.

“Ah…” The Xuanyuan Supreme Being and others sighed deeply.

They felt helpless, wishing they could take everyone along, but knowing the reality was impossible.

The more citizens they absorbed, the stronger the backlash during cosmic destruction. If they took on too many, they risked being overwhelmed by cosmic collapse, causing even greater losses.

Both the life within their Inner Universes and the Supremes themselves would face complete erasure.

“The migration plan has changed.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the Supremes and declared.

“Changed?”

The nine Supremes were startled internally—changed?

“I can take every human citizen along.” Lin Yuan cut straight to the point.

“Take them all?”

The nine Supremes exchanged looks, momentarily unable to process.

“Galaxy Supreme Being, taking all human civilization citizens would necessitate facing backlash from the cosmic origin consciousness…”

After a long silence, the Xuanyuan Supreme Being composed himself and cautiously mentioned it.

“Cosmic origin consciousness?”

Lin Yuan chuckled softly and said calmly:

“It can no longer stop me.”
